provider_receipt.summary: Read-only review completed. The digest-validated parent receipt supports only its bounded claim that the declared clean-tree check passed; it does not provide functional verification. Named implementation defects: MemoryStore::store serializes and discards records instead of persisting them (src/lib.rs:56-88); NoteFrontmatter is incompatible with the documented ingestion contract, including numeric rather than low/medium/high confidence and missing contract, authority, privacy, provenance, and review fields (src/lib.rs:13-25; docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md:71-94); wikilinks containing absolute paths or parent components can resolve outside the vault (src/lib.rs:183-192); traversal errors are silently discarded (src/lib.rs:110-114); and HumanKnowledge::new accepts an existing non-directory path (src/lib.rs:94-103). Existing tests do not cover these defects. No files were modified and no artifacts were created.
